task_groups.title: Implement GitRunner struct, NewRunner, Run, and RunExitCode

subtasks.title: Implement GitRunner struct and NewRunner constructor
details: Define GitRunner struct with unexported workDir string and env []string fields
Implement NewRunner(workDir string, env ...string) *GitRunner
Store a copy of the env slice at construction time to prevent external mutation
Do NOT validate workDir existence at construction time (raw os/exec error is returned at Run time)
Do NOT provide an AddEnv method — all env must be supplied at construction time
Add doc comment noting the runner is safe for concurrent use after construction

subtasks.title: Implement Run method with GitError on non-zero exit
details: Implement Run(ctx context.Context, args ...string) (stdout []byte, stderr []byte, err error)
Use exec.CommandContext(ctx, 'git', args...) with cmd.Dir = r.workDir
Set cmd.Env using buildEnv(os.Environ(), r.env) to apply safety defaults with deduplication
Capture stdout and stderr using bytes.Buffer (cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr)
On non-zero exit: return stdout, stderr, and a *GitError{Command: strings.Join(args, ' '), ExitCode: exitCode, Stderr: stderr}
On binary-not-found or other os/exec error: return the raw error directly (not wrapped in GitError)
On context cancellation: return partial stdout/stderr alongside the context error

subtasks.title: Implement RunExitCode method with system-error wrapping
details: Implement RunExitCode(ctx context.Context, args ...string) (stdout []byte, stderr []byte, exitCode int, err error)
Use same exec.CommandContext setup as Run (workDir, buildEnv, stdout/stderr capture)
On successful subprocess run (including non-zero exit): return stdout, stderr, exitCode, nil
On system-level failure: return partial stdout/stderr, raw ExitCode from exec.ExitError.ExitCode() (may be -1 for SIGKILL), and fmt.Errorf('%w', originalErr)
Do NOT produce a GitError from RunExitCode — system errors are wrapped via fmt.Errorf('%w', ...)
Document that exitCode == -1 means signal termination and should be treated as secondary context only when err != nil

subtasks.title: Implement BranchExists method with three-way exit code discrimination
details: Implement func (r *GitRunner) BranchExists(ctx context.Context, remote string, branch string) (bool, error)
Always prepend 'refs/heads/' to the branch parameter before passing to git ls-remote
Call RunExitCode with args: 'ls-remote', '--exit-code', remote, 'refs/heads/'+branch
Exit 0: return true, nil
Exit 2: return false, nil (branch genuinely missing)
Any other non-zero exit (1, 128, etc.): return false, fmt.Errorf('git ls-remote exited with code %d: %s', exitCode, stderr)
Add doc comment warning callers not to pass full ref paths and recommending a 30-second context deadline

subtasks.title: Implement CheckGitVersion with version string parsing
details: Implement func CheckGitVersion(ctx context.Context) error as a package-level function
Run 'git --version' using exec.CommandContext (not via GitRunner, since no workDir is needed)
Parse the output by extracting the first three dot-separated numeric components using regexp or strings scanning
Handle standard, Apple Git (trailing parenthetical), and release candidate (trailing .rc1) version strings
If fewer than three numeric components are found, return a parse error
If parsed version < 2.38, return error with format 'requires git >= 2.38, found <installed>'
Keep the minimum version floor (2.38) as an unexported constant — do not export it
Add doc comment recommending a 5-second context deadline for callers
